questions.text: Esha (fluctuating capital) has a closing capital of Rs. 6,30,000. Interest on capital @ 12% p.a. was allowed on the OPENING capital, profit credited Rs. 90,000, drawings Rs. 20,000. Esha's opening capital was:
questions.explanation: opening = 560000 / (1 + 12/100) = 500000  Correct option C. Distractors: A = took the closing balance as the opening; B = divided by (1 + 2*rate) instead of (1 + rate); D = forgot to divide by (1 + rate).
